description: Find Cigo Carsafe cabin air / pollen / car AC replacement filters by vehicle model, generation code and model year, including Korean and supported English names (e.g. Hyundai Santa Fe TM, Kia Sorento). Returns Korean-market reference fitment, dimensions, representative official product imagery and domestic purchase links for Cigo's own store, Naver and Coupang. The choice of merchant belongs to the user. These links do not create accounts, carts, orders, payments or stock reservations. Ambiguous matches require a vehicle year or generation. English names do not establish overseas vehicle compatibility, export availability or international shipping; those conditions require staff review. 차종·세대·연식별 차량용 에어컨/캐빈 필터 호환 규격과 국내 구매 경로 조회. 해외 사양 호환·공급·배송은 담당자 확인을 위한 문의로 안내합니다.Product lookups record channel labels and returned product codes for Cigo's usage analytics. The optional journey_token is a server-issued correlation value linking lookups and a later inquiry in the same customer conversation. Omission starts a new lookup journey.
